opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; some specialist arts institutions permitted. Host institution must agree to administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Enables UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research. Visits last 3-12 months.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher education institutions, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible per UKRI. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project, up to 5 years. Assessed via two-stage process (Outline and Detailed). The outline stage is currently paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; detailed applications are due by 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical, policy, commercial research

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK; permanent member of UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research, to complete a piece of research over 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on this page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; must live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks of the year and hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, over 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers. Each UK university may submit one application as principal applicant.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; at least two years post-PhD research/teaching experience; permanent appointment at lecturer level or equivalent, or nominated by a UK university.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical, policy, commercial research
